a: Sheim nata vehivrich vehirkiv — muttar.

Vechi tema, shane leh lerabbi yose ben shear issurin laavoda zara, umi shane leh? vehatanya: sade shennizdabbela bezevel avoda zara, vechen para shennitpattema becharshine avoda zara, tane chada: sade tizzara, para tishshachet, vetanya iddach: sade tavor, ufara tirze.
May lav ha rabbi yose, veha rabbanan? la, ha rabbi eliezer, veha rabbanan.
He rabbi eliezer verabbanan? ilema rabbi eliezer verabbanan disor.
Ditnan: seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch haissa, lo baze kede lechammetz velo baze kede lechammetz, venitztarfu vechimmetzu.
Rabbi eliezer omer: achar haacharon ani ba, vachachamim omrim: ben shennafal issur lechitchilla uven shennafal issur levassof, eno asur ad sheyyehe bo kede lechammetz.
Veamar abbaye: lo shanu ella shekkadam vesillek et haissur, aval lo kadam vesillek et haissur — asur.
Umimmay detama derabbi eliezer kidabbaye? dilma tama derabbi eliezer mishshum deachar acharon ani ba", i gemir beissura — asura, vei gemir behettera — muttarin, ben sallekeh uven la sallekeh!
Ella, rabbi eliezer verabbanan deetzim.
Ditnan: natal hemenna etzim — asura bahanaa. hissik bah et hattannur, chadash — yuttatz, yashan — yutzan. afa bo et happat — asura bahanaa.
Nitarva baacherim — kullan asurot bahanaa. rabbi eliezer omer: yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. amru lo: en pidyon laavoda zara.
Rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi eliezer, man ninhu?
Illema rabbanan deetzim, achmore machmeri!
Ella rabbanan disor, emar deshamat lehu lerabbanan dimkilli bisor, baavoda zara mi mekilli?
Ella leolam: ha rabbi yose veha rabbanan.
Rabbi yose ledivrehem derabbanan amar lehu: ledidi, ze vaze gorem muttar,
Ledidchu deamritu: ze vaze gorem — asur, odo li mihat af yerakot bimot haggeshamim!
Verabbanan? kidamar rav mari bereh derav kahana.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. hahu ginneta deizdabbal bezivla daavoda zara, shelach rav amram kammeh derav yosef. amar leh: hachi amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose.
b: Mishna natal mimmenna etzim — asurin bahanaa. hissik bahen et hattannur, im chadash — yuttatz, veim yashan — yutzan. afa bo et happat — asura bahanaa.
Nitarva baacherot — kullan asurot bahanaa, rabbi eliezer omer: yolich hanaa leyam hammelach, amru lo: en pidyon laavoda zara.

Natal hemenna karkevr — asur bahanaa. arag bo et habbeged — asur bahanaa. nitarev baacherim vaacherim baacherim — kullan asurin bahanaa. rabbi eliezer omer: yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. amru lo: en pidyon laavoda zara.
Gemara utzericha, dei ashmeinan kammayyta, beha kaamar rabbi eliezer, mishshum dividdana deka gamra pat kale la issura, aval karkevr deiteh leissura beeneh, ema mode lerabbanan.
Vei ashmeinan karkevr, beha kaamri rabbanan, aval pat — ema modu leh lerabbi eliezer. tzericha.
Amar rav chiyyay bereh derabba bar nachmani amar rav chisda amar zeeri: halacha kerabbi eliezer. ikka deamri, amar rav chisda: amar li abba bar rav chisda, hachi amar zeeri: halacha kerabbi eliezer.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: lo shanu ella pat, aval chavit — la, verav chisda amar: afillu chavit mutteret.
Hahu gavra deitarav leh chavita deyen nesech bechamreh, ata lekammeh derav chisda, amar: shekol arba zuze ushedi benahara, venishtere lach.
Mishna ketzad mevattelah? kirsem vezered, natal mimmenna makkel o sharvit, afillu ale — hare zo betela. shippah letzorkah — asura, shello letzorkah — mutteret.
Gemara otan shefain — ma tehe alehen? peligi ba rav huna verabbi chiyyay bar rav: chad amar asurin, vechad amar muttarin.

Tanya keman deamar muttarin, detanya: goy sheshshippa avoda zara letzorko — hi ushefaeha muttarin, letzorkah — hi asura ushefaeha muttarin, veyisrael sheshshippa avoda zara, ben letzorkah ben letzorko — hi ushefaeha asurin.
Ittemar: avoda zara shennishtabbera, rav amar: tzarich levattel kol kesam vekesam, ushemuel amar: avoda zara enah betela ella derech gedilatah.
Adderabba, derech gedilatah mi mevattela? ella hachi kaamar: en avoda zara tzericha levattel ella derech gedilatah.
Lema beha kamippalgi, demar savar: ovdin lishvarin, umar savar: en ovdin lishvarin?
La, dechulle alma ovdin lishvarin, vehacha beshivre shevarim kamippalgi, mar savar: shivre shevarim asurin, umar savar: shivre shevarim muttarin.

Vei baet ema: dechulle alma shivre shevarim muttarin, vehacha baavoda zara shel chulyot, uvehedyot sheyyachol lehachezirah kamippalgi. mar savar: kevan dehedyot yachol lehachezirah la batla, umar savar: en avoda zara betela ella derech gedilatah, dehayynu orcheh, ha lav gedilatah hi, veen tzericha levattel.
Hadaran alach kol hatztzelamim.
Mishna rabbi yishmael omer: shalosh avanim zo betzad zo betzad markulis — asurot, ushetayim — muttarot. vachachamim omrim: shennirot immo — asurot, vesheen nirot immo — muttarot.
Gemara bishlama rabbanan kasavri ovdin lishvarim, nirot immo deikka lememar minneh nefal — asurot, sheen nirot immo — muttarot.
Ella rabbi yishmael may kasavar? i ovdin lishvarin, afillu tarte name littesar! i en ovdin lishvarim, afillu telat name la!

Amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: beyadua shennashru mimmennu — divre hakkol asurot, vaafillu leman deamar: en ovdin lishvarim — hane mille avoda zara delav hayeynu orcheh, aval hacha demeikkara tabbore mittabberi — hayeynu orcheh, ki peligi bistama.

a: Bimkoravot name, deikka lememar minneh nefal — divre hakkol asurot, ki peligi — bimruchakot.
Veha "betzad markulis" katane, may "betzad"? betzad arba ammot dideh.

Rabbi yishmael savar: osin markulis katan betzad markulis gadol, shalosh dedomyayn lemarkulis — asurot, shetayim — muttarot. rabbanan savri: en osin markulis katan betzad markulis gadol, la shena shalosh vela shena shetayim, nirot immo — asurot, sheen nirot immo — muttarot.

Amar mar: beyadua shennashru mimmennu — divre hakkol asurot. ureminhi: avanim shennashru min hammarkulis, nirot immo — asurot, sheen nirot immo — muttarot. verabbi yishmael omer: shalosh — asurot, shetayim — muttarot. amar rava: la tema "shennashru", ella ema "shennimtzeu".
Vesavar rabbi yishmael shetayim muttarot? vehatanya: rabbi yishmael omer: shetayim bitfisa lo asurot, shalosh, afillu meruchakot — asurot!
Amar rava: la kashya, kan bitfisa achat, kan bishte tefisot, vehechi dame? deikka guveha bene uvene.
Umarkulis kehay gavvna mi have? veha tanya: ellu hen avne bet kulis — achat mikkan veachat mikkan veachat al gabbehen! amar rava: ki tanya hahi — beikkar markulis.
Be yannay malka charuv, ato goyim okimu beh markulis, ato goyim acharine dela palchi lemarkulis shaklinhu, vechippu bahen derachim usetartaot, ikka rabbanan defarshi veikka rabbanan dela parshi.

Amar rabbi yochanan: benan shel kedoshim mehallech alehen, vaanan nifrosh mehen? man nihu "benan shel kedoshim"? rabbi menachem berabbi simay, veammay karu leh "benan shel kedoshim"? daafillu betzureta dezuza la mistakkal.

May tama deman defaresh? savar la ki ha deamar rav giddel amar rav chiyyay bar yosef amar rav: minnayin letikrovet avoda zara sheen lah betila olamit? shenneemar: "vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim", ma met en lo betila leolam, af tikrovet avoda zara en lah betila leolam.
Uman dela paresh, amar: baena keen penim, velekka.
Amar rav yosef bar abba: ikkela rabba bar yirmeya leatrin, vaata veayyti matnita bideh: goy shehevi avanim min hammarkulis vechippa bahen derachim useratyaot —
b: Muttarot, yisrael shehevi avanim min hammarkulis vechippa bahen derachim useratyaot — asurot, velet naggar vela bar naggar deyifrekinna.
Amar rav sheshet: ana la naggar ana vela bar naggar ana, ufarekna leh: may kusheya leh? derav giddel. baena keen penim, velekka.
Amar rav yosef bar abba: ikkela rabba bar yirmeya leatrin, vaata veayyti matnita bideh: matliin umezahamin bashsheviit, veen matliin umezahamin bammoed.
Kan vechan en megazzemin, vesachin shemen ligzom, ben bammoed ben bashsheviit. velet naggar vela bar naggar deyifrekinna.

Amar ravina: ana la naggar ana vela bar naggar ana, umefarekyna la: may ka kashya leh? illema moed ashsheviit ka kashya leh — may shena sheviit deshare, umay shena moed deasur? mi dame?! sheviit — melacha asar rachamana, tircha shere; moed — afillu tircha name asur.
Veella zihum aggizzum ka kashya leh: may shena zihum deshare, umay shena gizzum deasur? mi dame?! zihum — okome ilana, ushere; gizzum — avroye ilana, veasur.

Veella, zihum azzihum ka kashya leh, dekatane: matliin umezahamin bashsheviit, ureminhi: mezahamin et hannetiot, vechorchin otan, vekotmin otan, veosin lahem battim, umashkin otan ad rosh hashshana — ad rosh hashshana in, bishviit la!

Vedilma kidrav ukeva bar chama, deamar rav ukeva bar chama: tere kishkushe havu, chad leavroye ilana veasur, vechad lesattome pile ushere. hachi name tere zihume have, chad leokome ilane ushere, vechad leavroye ilane veasur!

Veella, sicha assicha ka kashya leh, dekatane: sachin shemen ligzom ben bammoed uven bashsheviit, ureminhi: sachin et happaggin umenakkevin umefattemin otan ad rosh hashshana — ad rosh hashshana in, bishviit la!
Mi dame?! hacha okome ilana, ushere; hatam pattome pera, vaasir!

Amar leh rav samma bereh derav ashe leravina bar yirmeya: sicha demoed azzihum demoed ka kashya leh, mikkedi hay okome vehay okome, may shena hay dishre umay shena hay daasivr? hayeynu dekaamar leh: let naggar vela bar naggar deyifrekinna.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: avoda zara sheovdin otah bemakkel, shavar makkel befaneha — chayyayv, zarak makkel befaneha — patur. amar leh abbaye lerava: may shena shavar dahava leh keen zevicha, zarak name hava leh keen zerika! amar leh: baena zerika mishtabberet, velekka.
Etiveh: safat lah tzoa, o shennissech lefaneha avit shel meme raglayim —

a: Chayyayv, bishlama avit shel meme raglayim — ikka zerika mishtabberet, ella tzoa, may zerika mishtabberet ikka? betzoa lacha.
Lema ketannae: shachat lah chagav — rabbi yehuda mechayyev, vachachamim potrim.
May lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: amrinan keen zevicha, umar savar: la amrinan keen zevicha, ella keen penim?
La, dechulle alma la amrinan keen zevicha, ella keen penim baenan, veshane chagav hoil vetzavvaro dome letzavvar behema.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: avoda zara sheovdin otah bemakkel, shavar makkel befaneha — chayyayv veneeseret, zarak makkel lefaneha — chayyayv veenah neeseret.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: may shena shavar dehavya leh keen zevicha, zarak name havya leh keen zerika! amar leh: baenan zerika mishtabberet, velekka.

Ella meatta, avne bet markulis bamme yeasru? amar leh: af ledidi kashya li, usheelteh lerabba bar avu, verabba bar avu lechiyyay bar rav, vechiyyay bar rav lerav, vaamar leh: naasa kimgaddel avoda zara.
Hanicha leman deamar: avoda zara shel goy asura miyyad, ella leman deamar ad shetteaved, tishtere, deha la palcha! amar leh: kol achat veachat naaset avoda zara, vetikrovet lachavertah.
I hachi, batrayyta miha tishtere! amar leh: i yadat la, zil shikla. rav ashe amar: kol achat veachat naaset tikrovet leatzmah vetikrovet lachavertah.
Tenan: matza berosho kesut umaot o chelim — hare ellu muttarin, parkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolim veyenot shemanim uselatot vechol davar shekkayyotze bo karev legabbe mizbeach — asur.
Bishlama yenot shemanim uselatot — ikka keen penim, veikka keen zerika mishtabberet, ella parkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolim — la keen penim ikka, vela keen zerika mishtabberet ikka!
Amar rava amar ulla: kegon shebbetzaran mittechilla lechach.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin lazzoveach behema baalat mum laavoda zara shehu patur? shenneemar: "zoveach laelohim yochoram bilti laAdonai levaddo", lo asra tora ella keen penim.
Have be rava, bemay? ilema bedukkin shebbaayin — hasheta livne noach chazya legavoah bevama didhu, laavoda zara mibbaya?

Ella bimchussar ever, vechidrabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: minnayin limchussar ever shehu asur livne noach? shenneemar: "umikkol hachay mikkol basar shenayim mikkol", amra tora: have behema shechayyin rashe evarin shellah.
Hay "umikkol hachay" mibbee leh lemaote terefa! millehachayot zera" nafka.
Hanicha leman deamar: terefa enah yoledet, ella leman deamar: terefa yoledet, may ikka lememar?
Amar kera: "ittach", "ittach" — bedomin lach. vedilma noach gufeh terefa hava! "tamim" ketiv beh.
Dilma "tamim" bidrachav! "tzaddik" ketiv beh.
Dilma "tamim" bidrachav, vetzaddik" bemaasav! la matzet amrat denoach gufeh terefa hava, dei salka datach noach terefa hava, amar leh rachamana: dichvavtach ayyel, shalmin la teayyel?
Hasheta denafka meittach", "lehachayot zera" lema li? i meittach", hava amena letzavvta bealma, vaafillu zaken vaafillu saris, ka mashma lan "lehachayot zera".

Amar rabbi elazar: minnayin lashshochet behema lemarkulis shehu chayyayv? shenneemar: "velo yizbechu od et zivchehem lasseirim", im eno inyan lichdarkah, dichtiv: "echa yaavdu haggoyim haelle et elohehem", tenehu inyan leshello kedarkah.
Veha lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh lechidtanya:
b: Ad kan hu medabber bekadashim shehikdishan bishat issur habbamot, vehikrivan bishat issur habbamot,
Shehare onshan amur, shenneemar: "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio vegomer". onesh shamanu, azhara minnayin? talmud lomar: "pen taale olotecha".
Vechidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila, deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer" ufen" veal" — eno ella belo taase.
Mikkan veelach hu medabber bekadashim shehikdishan bishat hetter habbamot, vehikrivan bishat issur habbamot.

Shenneemar: "lemaan asher yaviu bene yisrael et zivchehem asher hem zovchim", shehittarti lecha kevar, "al pene hassade", melammed shekkol hazzoveach bevama bishat issur habbamot, maale alav hakkatuv keillu hu zoveach al pene hassade.
"Veheviam laAdonai" — zo mitzvat ase, umitzvat lo taase minnayin? talmud lomar: "velo yizbechu od et zivchehem".
Yachol yehe anush karet? talmud lomar: "chukkat olam tihye zot lahem", zot lahem, velo acheret lahem.
Amar rava: keri beh "velo yizbechu", ukeri beh "velo od".
Mishna matza berosho maot, kesut o chelim — hare ellu muttarin. parkile anavim, vaatarot shel shibbolim, veyenot ushemanim uselatot, vechol davar shekkayyotze bo karev al gabbe hammizbeach — asur.

Gemara menahane mille? amar rav chiyyay bar yosef amar rabbi oshaya: katuv echad omer "vattiru et shikkutzehem veet gillulehem etz vaeven kesef vezahav asher immahem", vechatuv echad omer "lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem", ha ketzad?
"Immahem" duvmya daalehem", ma "alehem" — davar shel noy asur, sheeno shel noy muttar, af "immahem" — davar shel noy asur, vesheeno shel noy muttar.
Veema: "alehem" dumeya deimmahem", ma "immahem" — kol ma sheimmahem, af "alehem" — kol shealehem! im ken, lo yeamer "alehem".
Maot, davar shel noy hu! amri deve rabbi yannay: bakkis kashur vetaluy lo betzavvaro.
Kesut, davar shel noy hu! amri deve rabbi yannay: bichsut mekuppelet umunnachat lo al rosho. keli, davar shel noy hu! amar rav pappa: dischifa leh mashkilta aresheh.

Amar rav assi bar chiyyay: kol shehu lifnim min hakkilkelin, afillu mayim umelach asur. chutz lekilkelin — davar shel noy asur, sheeno shel noy muttar. amar rabbi yose bar chanina: naktinan, en kilkelin lo lifor velo lemarkulis.
Lemay? ilema daafillu penim kechutz dame veshare — hasheta paore mefaarin kammeh, mayim umelach la makrevin leh?! ella, afillu chutz kevifnim dame veasur.

Mishna avoda zara shehaya lah ginna o merchatz — nehenin mehen shello betova, veen nehenin mehen betova. haya shellah veshel acherim — nehenin mehen ben betova uven shello betova. avoda zara shel nochri — asura miyyad, veshel yisrael — en asura ad shetteaved.
Gemara amar abbaye: betova — betovat komarin, shello betova — shello betovat komarin, leappoke tovat ovdeha dishre.
Ikka dematne la assefa — haya shellah veshel acherim, nehenin mehen betova veshello betova. amar abbaye: betova — betovat acherim, shello betova — shello betovat komarin.
Man dematne assefa — kol shekken aresha, uman dematne aresha — aval assefa, kevan deikka acherim bahada, afillu betovat komarin name shappir dame.

Avoda zara shel nochri asura miyyad. matnitin manni? rabbi akiva hi, detanya: "abbed teabbedun et kol hammekomot asher avdu sham haggoyim", bechelim shennishtammeshu bahen laavoda zara hakkatuv medabber.

Yachol asaum velo gemarum, gemarum velo hevium, hevium velo nishtammeshu bahen, yachol yehu asurim? talmud lomar: "asher avdu sham haggoyim", sheen asurin ad sheyyeavdu; mikkan amru: avoda zara shel nochri enah asura ad shetteaved, veshel yisrael asura miyyad, divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: chilluf haddevarim, avoda zara shel nochri asura miyyad, veshel yisrael ad shetteaved.
Amar mar: bechelim shennishtammeshu bahen laavoda zara hakkatuv medabber. ha "mekomot" ketiv, im eno inyan limkomot dela mittasri, dichtiv: "elohehem al heharim", velo heharim elohehem,

a: Tenehu inyan lechelim, mikkan amru: avoda zara shel nochri enah asura ella ad shetteaved, veshel yisrael miyyad.

Veha bechelim okemna la! amar kera: "asher attem yorshim otam et elohehem", makkish elohehem lechelim, ma kelim ad sheyyeavedu, af elohehem name ad sheyyeavedu. verabbi akiva dela makkesh, amar lach: "et" hifsik hainyan.

Verabbi yishmael, ashkechan avoda zara shel nochri deen asura ad shetteaved, deyisrael daasura miyyad mena leh? sevara hu, middenochri ad shetteaved, deyisrael asura miyyad. ema: deyisrael kelal uchelal la! hasheta geniza baaya, ittesore la mittasra?
Veema kidnochri! amar kera: "veet chattatchem asher asitem et haegel", mishsheat asiyyay kam leh bechet.
Ema: hane mille lemekam gavra bechet, ittesore la mittasra! amar kera: "arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha", mishsheat asiyyay kam leh bearur.
Ema hane mille lemekam gavra bearur", ittesore la mittasra! "toavat Adonai" ketiv.
Verabbi akiva? davar hammevi lide toeva.
Verabbi akiva, avoda zara shel nochri daasura miyyad mena leh? amar ulla, amar kera: "pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh", mishsheppisselo naase eloah.
Veiddach, hahu mibbee leh lechidtane rav yosef, detane rav yosef: minnayin legoy shepposel eloho? shenneemar: "pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh".
Veiddach, nafka leh middishmuel, dishmuel rame: ketiv "lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem", uchetiv "velakachta lach". ha ketzad? pisselo leeloah — "lo tachmod", pesalo meeloah — "velakachta lach".
Verabbi akiva, ashkechan avoda zara shel nochri daasura miyyad, deyisrael ad shetteaved menalan? amar rav yehuda amar kera: "vesam bassater", ad sheyyaase lah devarim shebbasseter.
Veiddach? hahu mibbaya leh lechidrabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin laavoda zara shel yisrael shetteuna geniza? shenneemar: "vesam bassater".

Veiddach? nafka leh midderav chisda amar rav, deamar rav chisda amar rav: minnayin laavoda zara shel yisrael shetteuna geniza? shenneemar: "lo titta lecha ashera kol etz etzel mizbach", ma mizbeach taun geniza, af ashera teuna geniza.

Veiddach? hahu mibbee leh lechidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: kol hammaamid dayyayn sheeno hagun — keillu notea ashera beyisrael, shenneemar: "shoftim veshotrim titten lecha bechol shearecha", usemich leh: "lo titta lecha ashera kol etz".
Amar rav ashe: uvimkom talmide chachamim, keillu netao etzel mizbeach, shenneemar: "etzel mizbach".

Bae rav hamenuna: rittech keli laavoda zara, mahu? avoda zara deman? ilema avoda zara denochri, ben lerabbi yishmael uven lerabbi akiva meshammeshe avoda zara hen, umeshammeshe avoda zara en asurin ad sheyyeavedu! ella avoda zara deyisrael.
Allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbi akiva, hasheta hi gufa la mittasra ad shetteaved, meshammesheha mibbaya? veella allibba derabbi yishmael, deamar: "asura miyyad".
May meshammeshin? memashmeshin gamrinan, ma hatam ad sheyyeavedu, af hacha ad sheyyeavedu, o dilma minna gamar, ma hi asura miyyad, af meshammesheha asurin miyyad?
May irya deka mibbaya leh rittech keli? tibbee leh asa!
Rav hamenuna mishshum tumea yeshana kamibbaya leh, ditnan: kele mattachot, peshutehen umekabbelehen temein, nishtabberu taheru, chazar vaasaan kelim — yachzeru letumea yeshana.
Vehachi kamibbaya leh: ki hadra tumea — hane mille letumea deorayyta, aval tumea derabbanan — la, o dilma la shena? vetibbee leh shear tumeot derabbanan.

Chada miggo chada kamibbaya leh, tumea derabbanan mi hadra o la hadra? veim timtze lomar la hadra, tumea daavoda zara mishshum chumera daavoda zara mi shavveyuha rabbanan ketumea deorayyta o la? teku.
Bae minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay: tikrovet avoda zara shel ochalim, mahu? mi mahane lehu bittul letahorinhu mittumea, o la?
Vetibbee leh kelim! kelim la kamibbaya leh, kevan deit lehu tohora bemikve — tumea name batla; ki kamibbaya leh — ovchalin.
Vetibbee leh avoda zara gufa! avoda zara gufa la mibbaya leh,
b: Kevan deissura batel, tumea name batla. ki ka mibbaya leh tikrovet laavoda zara shel ochlin, may? kevan deissureh la batel, kidrav giddel, tumea name la batla, o dilma issur deorayyta la batel, tumea derabbanan batel? teku.
Bea minneh rabbi yose ben shaul merabbi: kelim sheshshimmeshu bahen bevet chonyo, mahu sheyyishtammeshu bahen bevet hammikdash?
Veka mibbaya leh, allibba deman deamar bet chonyo lav bet avoda zara hi, ditnan: kohanim sheshshimmeshu bevet chonyo lo yeshammeshu bammikdash shebbirushalayim, veeno tzarich lomar ledavar acher.
Kohanim hu dekansinhu rabbanan, mishshum divne dea ninhu, aval kelim — la, o dilma la shena?
Amar lo: asurim hen, umikra haya beyadenu ushechachnuhu.
Etiveh: "kol hakkelim asher hizniach hammelech achaz bemalchuto bemaalo hechannu vehikdashnu", may lav "hechannu" — deatbelinnanhu, "hikdashnu" — deakdeshinnanhu?
Amar lo: baruch atta lashshamayim shehechzarta li avedati. "hechannu" — sheggenaznum, vehikdashnu" — shehikdashnu acherim tachtehem.
Lema mesayyay leh: mizrachit tzefonit — bah ganzu bet chashmonay et avne hammizbeach sheshshikketzu anshe yavan, veamar rav sheshet: sheshshikketzu laavoda zara.
Amar rav pappa: hatam kera ashkach uderash, dichtiv: "uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha".
Amri: hechi naaved? nitberinhu? "avanim shelemot" amar rachamana! nenasserinhu? "lo tanif alehem barzel" amar rachamana.

Veammay? litberinhu velishkelinhu lenafshayyhu! mi la amar rav oshaya: "bikkeshu lignoz kol kesef vezahav shebbaolam mishshum kaspa vedahava shel yerushalayim", vehavenan ba: yerushalayim havya rubba dealma?
Ella amar abbaye: bikkeshu lignoz dinara haderyayna tureyayna shifa, mippene tivah shel yerushalayim, ad shemmatzu lah mikra min hattora shehu muttar, "uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha"!
Hatam, la ishtammashu behu legavoah; hacha, kevan deishtammash behu legavoah — lav orach ara leishtammoshe behu hedyota.

Mishna nochri mevattel avoda zara shello, veshel chavero, veyisrael en mevattel avoda zara shel nochri. hamevattel avoda zara — mevattel meshammesheha, bittel meshammesheha — meshammeshin muttarin, vehi asura.

Gemara matne leh rabbi lerabbi shimon berabbi: nochri mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero. amar lo: rabbi, shanita lanu beyaldutecha nochri mevattel avoda zara shello veshel yisrael. deyisrael mi ka mevattelah? veha "vesam bassater" ketiv! amar rabbi hillel bereh derabbi vavles: lo nitzrecha sheyyesh lo bah shuttafut.

Beyalduto may kasavar, uveziknuto may kasavar? beyalduto savar: yisrael addata denochri palach, kevan denochri mevattel denafsheh, deyisrael name mevattelah. uveziknuto savar: yisrael addata denafsheh palach, ki mevattel nochri denafsheh, deyisrael la batel.
Ikka dematne la assefa: yisrael eno mevattel avoda zara shel nochri. peshita! amar rabbi hillel bereh

a: Derabbi vavles: lo nitzrecha sheyyesh lo bah shuttafut, veka mashma lan yisrael hu dela mevattel denochri, aval nochri denafsheh mevattel.

Ikka dematne la abbarayyta, rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: avoda zara shel yisrael en lah betila olamit. may "olamit"? amar rabbi hillel bereh derabbi vavles: lo nitzrecha, ella sheyyesh lo legoy bah shuttafut, veka mashma lan deyisrael addata denafsheh palach.

Mishna ketzad mevattelah? kata rosh oznah, rosh chotmah, rosh etzbaah, pechasah — af al pi shello chisserah — bittelah; rak befaneha, hishtin befaneha, gerrah, zarak bah et hatztzoa — hare zo enah betela; mecharah o mishkenah — rabbi omer: bittel, vachachamim omrim: lo bittel.
Gemara ki lo chisserah, bemay bittelah? amar rav zera: sheppechasah befaneha.
Rakak befaneha, vehishtin befaneha. menahane mille?

Amar chizkiyya, deamar kera: "vehaya chi yirav vehitkatztzaf vekillel bemalko uvelohav ufana lemala", uchetiv batreh: "veel eretz yabbit vehinne tzara vachashecha vegomer", deaf al gav dekillel malko velohav ufana lemala, el eretz yabbit.

Mecharah o mishkenah, rabbi omer: bittel vechulei. zeeri amar rabbi yochanan, verabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav, chad amar: machloket betzoref goy, aval betzoref yisrael — divre hakkol bittel, vechad amar: betzoref yisrael machloket.
Ibbaya lehu: betzoref yisrael machloket, aval tzoref goy divre hakkol lo bittel, o dilma ben baze uven baze machloket?
Ta shema, deamar rabbi: nirin devarayy keshemmecharah lechabbelah, vedivre chaverayy shemmecharah leovdah.
May "lechabbelah" umay "leovdah"? illema lechabbelah — lechabbelah mammash, leovdah — leovdah mammash, may tama deman deamar bittel, umay tama deman deamar lo bittel?
Ella lav lechabbelah — lemi sheatid lechabbelah, umannu? tzoref yisrael. leovdah — lemi sheatid leovdah, umannu? tzoref goy. ushema minna: ben baze uven baze machloket.
La, hachi kaamar: amar rabbi: nirin devarayy lachaverayy keshemmecharah lechabbelah. umannu? tzoref yisrael, sheaf chaverayy lo nechleku alay ella keshemmecharah leovdah, aval lechabbelah — modu li.
Metivi: hallokeach gerutaot min haggoyim umatza bahen avoda zara, im ad shello natan maot mashach — yachazir, im mishshennatan maot mashach — yolich leyam hammelach.
I amrat bishlama betzoref yisrael machloket, ha manni? rabbanan hi. ella i amrat betzoref goy machloket, aval betzoref yisrael divre hakkol bittel, ha manni?
Shane hatam, deaddata digrutaot zabben, addata daavoda zara la zabben.
Tanu rabbanan: lava aleha, o shennafla aleha mappolet, o sheggenavuha listin, o shehinnichuha habbealim vehalchu limdinat hayyam,
b: Im atidin lachzor kemilchemet yehoshua — enah betela.
Utzericha, dei tena lava aleha — middela zabbena, la battela; aval nafla aleha mappolet — middela ka mefanne la, ema battole battela, tzericha.
Vei tena nafla aleha mappolet, mishshum desavar: ha mannecha, kol emat devaena la shakelna la, aval genavuha listim, middela ka mahdar abbatra — battole battela, tzericha.

Vei tena genavuha listin, mishshum desavar: i goy shakel la — miflach palach la, i yisrael shakla — ayyeyde dedameha yekarin mezabben la legoy ufalach la, aval hinnichuha habbealim vehalchu limdinat hayyam, middela shaklu bahadayyhu — battole batteluha, tzericha.
Im atidin lachzor kemilchemet yehoshua — enah betela. midde milchemet yehoshua mihdar hadur? hachi kaamar: im atidin lachzor — hare hu kemilchemet yehoshua, veen lah betila.
Ulema li lemitleyay bemilchemet yehoshua? milleta aggav orche ka mashma lan, ki ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: yisrael shezzakaf levena lehishtachavot lah, uva goy vehishtachava lah — asarah.
Menalan daasarah? amar rabbi elazar: kattechilla shel eretz yisrael, deamar rachamana "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh", mikkede yerushsha hi lahem meavotehem, veen adam oser davar sheeno shello!
Vei mishshum hanach demeikkara, bevittula bealma saggi lehu!

Ella, middiflachu yisrael leegel, gallo addatayyhu denicha lehu baavoda zara, vechi ato goyim, shelichuta didhu avdi. hachi name, yisrael shezzakaf levena, galli dateh denicha leh baavoda zara, vechi ata goy ufelach la, shelichuta dideh kaaved.
Vedilma beegel hu denicha lehu, bemidde acharina la? amar kera: "elle elohecha yisrael", melammed sheiuu leelohot harebe.
Ema: kol devahade egel nittasru, mikkan veelach nishtere? man mochach?
Mishna avoda zara shehinnichuha ovdeha — bishat shalom mutteret, bishat milchama asura. bimosyaot shel melachim — hare ellu muttarot, mippene shemmaamidin otah beshaa shehammelachim ovrim.

Gemara amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav: bet nimrod hare hi kaavoda zara shehinnichuha ovdeha bishat shalom, umuttar. af al gav dechi badderinhu rachamana kishat milchama dame, i (baaya) [beo] lemihdar hadur, middela hadur battole batteluha.
Bimosyaot shel melachim — hare ellu muttarot. vechi mippene shemmaamidin otah beshaa shehammelachim ovrin muttarin?
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, hachi kaamar: mippene shemmaamidin otan beshaa shehammelachim ovrin, umelachim mannichin derech zo veholchin bederech acheret.

Ki ata ulla, yatev abbimsa pegima. amar leh rav yehuda leulla: veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: bimos shennifgam asur! vaafillu leman deamar: en ovdim lishvarim — hane mille avoda zara, dezila beh milleta lemiflach lishvarim, aval hay la ichpat leh!

Amar leh: man yahev lan meafra derav ushemuel umalinan ayynin? ha rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: bimos shennifgam — muttar, vaafillu leman deamar ovdin lishvarim, hane mille avoda zara, dechevan defalcha — zila beh milleta levattola, aval hane shakli lehay umayytu bimos acharina.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan veresh lakish: bimos shennifgam — muttar, mizbeach shennifgam — asur ad sheyyinnatetz rubbo. hechi dame bimos, hechi dame mizbeach? amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yochanan: bimos — even achat, mizbeach — avanim harebe.

a: Amar chizkiyya: may kera "besumo kol avne mizbeach keavne gir menuppatzot lo yakumu asherim vechammanim"? i ikka "keavne gir menuppatzot" — lo yekumun asherim vechammanim, i lav — yakumu.

Tana: neevad shello asur, veshel chavero muttar. ureminhi: ezehu neevad? kol sheovdim oto ben beshogeg uven bemezid, ben beones uven beratzon. hay ones hechi dame? lav kegon deanas behemat chavero vehishtachava lah?
Amar rame bar chama: la, kegon sheanasuhu goyim vehishtachava livhemto dideh. matkef la rabbi zera: ones rachamana patreh, dichtiv "velannaara lo taase davar"!
Ella amar rava: hakkol hayu bichlal "lo taovdem", ucheshepparat lecha hakkatuv "vachay bahem" velo sheyyamut bahem — yatza ones.
Vahadar ketav rachamana: "velo techallelu et shem kodshi", daafillu beones. ha ketzad? ha betzina, veha befarhesya.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: tanya dimsayyeya lach, bimosyaot shel goyim bishat hashshemad — af al pi shehashshemad batel, otan bimosyaot lo batlu.
Amar lehu: i mishshum ha la tesayyeyan, emar yisrael meshummad hava ufelach la beratzon. rav ashe amar: la tema "emar", ella vadday yisrael meshummad hava ufelach la beratzon.
Chizkiyya amar, kegon shennissech laavoda zara yayin al karneha. matkef la rav adda bar ahava: hay neevad hu? hay bimos bealma hu, vesharyeh!

Ella amar rav adda bar ahava: kegon shennissech lah yayin ben karneha, daavad ba maase, vechi ha daata ulla amar rabbi yochanan: af al pi sheamru hammishtachave levehemat chavero lo asra, asa bah maase — asarah.

Amar lehu rav nachman: puku veemaru leh leulla, kevar targema rav huna lishmataych bevavel, deamar rav huna: hayta behemat chavero revutza bifne avoda zara, kevan sheshshachat bah siman echad — asarah.
Mena lan daasarah? illema mikkohanim, vedilma shane kohanim divne dea ninhu!
Veella meavne mizbeach, vedilma kidrav pappa?
b: Veella mikkelim, dichtiv: "veet kol hakkelim asher hizniach hammelech achaz bemalchuto bemaalo hechannu vehikdashnu", veamar mar: "hechannu" — sheggenaznum, "vehikdashnu" — shehikdashnu acherim tachtehen, veha en adam oser davar sheeno shello!
Ella, kevan daavad behu maase, ittesaru lehu; hacha name, kevan sheasa bah maase — asarah.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: af al pi sheamru hammishtachave lekarka olam lo asarah, chafar bah borot shichin umearot — asarah. ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar rabbi yochanan: af al pi sheamru hammishtachave levaale chayyim lo asaran, asaan chalifin laavoda zara — asaran.
Ki ata ravin amar: peligu ba rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yose verabbanan, chad amar: chalifin asurin, chalife chalifin muttarin, vechad amar: afillu chalife chalifin name asurin.
May tama deman deamar chalife chalifin asurin? amar kera: "vehayita cherem kamohu", kol sheatta mehayye mimmennu hare hu kamohu. veiddach, amar kera: "hu" — hu velo chalife chalifin.
Veiddach, hahu mibbee leh lemaote orla vechile hakkerem, sheim mecharan vekiddesh bidmehen — mekuddeshet.
Veiddach, orla vechile hakkerem la tzerichi miuta, dehavya lehu avoda zara usheviit shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Avoda zara — ha daamaran, sheviit — dichtiv: "ki yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem", ma kodesh tofes et damav veasur, af sheviit tofeset et dameha vaasura.
I ma kodesh tofes et damav veyotze lechullin, af sheviit tofeset et dameha veyotza lechullin! talmud lomar: "tihye", bahavayaytah tehe.

Ha ketzad? lakach beferot sheviit basar — ellu veellu mitbaarin bashsheviit, lakach babbasar dagim — yatza basar nichnesu dagim, baddagim yayin — yatzu dagim nichnas yayin, bayyayin shemen — yatza yayin venichnas shemen, ha ketzad? acharon acharon nitpas bishviit, uferi atzmo asur.
Veiddach, kasavar: shene chetuvin habbain keechad melammedin, veitzterich "hu" lemaotinhu.

Mishna shaalu et hazzekenim beromi: im en retzono baavoda zara, lama eno mevattelah? amru lahen: illu ledavar sheen tzorech laolam bo hayu ovdin — haya mevattelo, hare hen ovdin lachamma velallevana velakkochavim velammazzalot, yeabbed olamo mippene hashshotim?!

Amru lahen: im ken, yeabbed davar sheen tzorech laolam bo, veyanniach davar shetztzorech haolam bo! amru lahen: af anu machazikin yede ovdehen shel ellu, sheomrim: tedu shehen elohot, shehare hen lo batlu.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shaalu filosofin et hazzekenim beromi: im elohechem en retzono baavoda zara, mippene ma eno mevattelah? amru lahem: illu ledavar sheen haolam tzorech lo hayu ovdin, hare hu mevattelah. hare hen ovdin lachamma velallevana velakkochavim velammazzalot, yeabbed olam mippene hashshotim? ella olam keminhago noheg, veshotim shekkilkelu atidin litten et haddin.
Davar acher: hare sheggazal sea shel chittim [vehalach] uzeraah bakkarka — din hu shello titzmach, ella olam keminhago noheg veholech, veshotim shekkilkelu atidin litten et haddin.
Davar acher: hare shebba al eshet chavero — din hu shello titabber, ella olam keminhago noheg veholech, veshotim shekkilkelu atidin litten et haddin.
Vehayeynu deamar resh lakish: amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lo dayyayn larshaim sheosin sela shelli pumebe, ella shemmatrichin oti umachtimin oti beal korchi.
Shaal filosofus echad et rabban gamliel: katuv betoratchem "ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna", mippene ma mitkanne beovdeha veen mitkanne bah?

Amar lo: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam shehaya lo ben echad, veoto habben haya megaddel lo et hakkelev veheela lo shem al shem aviv, ucheshehu nishba omer: "bechayye kelev abba", kesheshshama hammelech, al mi hu koes, al habben hu koes o al hakkelev hu koes? heve omer: al habben hu koes.
Amar lo: kelev atta kore otah? vahalo yesh bah mammash! amar lo: uma raita? amar lo: paam achat nafla deleka beirenu, venisrefa kol hair kullah, veoto bet avoda zara lo nisraf!
Amar lo: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam shessarcha alav medina, keshehu ose milchama, im hachayyim hu ose o im hammetim hu ose? heve omer: im hachayyim hu ose.

Amar lo: kelev atta kore otah, met atta kore otah, im ken yeabbedenna min haolam! amar lo: illu ledavar sheen haolam tzarich lo hayu ovdin, hare hu mevattelah, hare hen ovdin lachamma velallevana, lakkochavim velammazzalot, laafikim velaggeayot, yeabbed olamo mippene shotim? vechen hu omer:

a: "Asof asef kol meal pene haadama neum Adonai, asef adam uvehema asef of hashshamayim udege hayyam vehammachshelot et harshaim [vegomer]", vechi mippene sheharshaim nichshalim bahen yeabbedem min haolam? vahalo leadam hen ovdin, "vehichratti et haadam meal pene haadama [vegomer]".
Shaal agrippas sar tzava et rabban gamliel: ketiv betoratchem: "ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna", kelum mitkanne ella chacham bechacham, vegibbor begibbor, veashir beashir?
Amar lo: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? leadam shennasa ishsha al ishto, chashuva mimmenna — en mitkannea bah, pechuta mimmenna — mitkannea bah.
Amar leh zunin lerabbi akiva: libbi velibbach yada daavoda zara let ba meshasha, veha kachazenan gavre deazli ki metabberi veatu ki metzammedi! may tama?

Amar lo: emshol lecha mashal, lema haddavar dome? leadam neeman shehaya bair, vechol bene iro hayu mafkidin etzlo shello beedim, uva adam echad vehifkid lo beedim. paam echad shachach vehifkid etzlo shello beedim, amra lo ishto: bo venichperennu, amar lah: vechi mippene sheshshote ze asa shello kahogen anu neabbed et emunatenu?

Af kach yissurin, beshaa shemmeshaggerin otan al haadam, mashbiin otan: shello telchu ella beyom peloni, velo tetzu ella beyom peloni uveshaa pelonit, veal yede peloni veal yede sam peloni. kevan shehiggia zemannan latzet, halach ze levet avoda zara, amru yissurin: din hu shello netze, vechozrin veomrim: vechi mippene sheshshote ze ose shello kahogen anu neabbed shevuatenu?
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "vocholayim raim veneemanim"? raim bishlichutan, veneemanim bishvuatan.

Amar leh rava bar rav yitzchak lerav yehuda: haikka bet avoda zara beatrin, dechi mitzterich alma lemitra, mitchaze lehu bechelma veamar lehu: shachatu li gavra veayyte mitra — shachatu la gavra veate mitra!

Amar leh: hasheta (i havay) [ikko] shachevna, la amari lechu ha milleta, deamar rav: may dichtiv "asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam lechol haammim"? melammed shehechlikan bidvarim, kede letordan min haolam.
Vehayeynu deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "im lalletzim hu yalitz velaanavim yitten chen"? ba littamme — potchin lo, ba littaher — mesayyeyin oto.
Mishna lokchin gat beuta min hannochri, af al pi shehu notel beyado venoten lattappuach, veeno ose yen nesech ad sheyyered labbor. yarad labbor — ma shebbabbor asur, vehashshear muttar.
Dorchin im hannochri baggat,
b: Aval lo botzrin immo. yisrael shehu ose betumea — lo dorchin velo botzrin immo, aval molichin immo chaviyyot laggat, umeviin immo min haggat.
Nachtom shehu ose betumea — lo lashin velo orchin immo, aval molichin immo pat lefalter.

Gemara amar rav huna: yayin, kevan shehitchil lehimmashech, ose yen nesech. tenan: lokchim gat beuta min hannochri, veaf al pi shennatal beyado venatan lattappuach! amar rav huna: begat pekuka umelea.
Ta shema, veeno ose yen nesech ad sheyyered labbor! hacha name begat pekuka umelea.
Ta shema: yarad labbor — ma shebbabbor asur, vehashshear muttar. amar rav huna: la kashya — kan bemishna rishona, kan bemishna acharona.

Detanya: barishona hayu omrim 10 — en botzrin im hannochri baggat, sheasur ligrom tumea lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael, veen dorchin im yisrael sheose perotav betumea, sheasur lesayyea yede ovre avera, aval dorchim im hannochri baggat, vela chayyshinan lidrav huna.
Vechazru lomar 8 — en dorchin im hannochri baggat, mishshum derav huna.

a: Veen botzrin im yisrael sheose perotav betumea, vechol shekken sheen dorchin, aval botzrin im hannochri baggat, shemmuttar ligrom tumea lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael.
Veeno ose yen nesech ad sheyyered levor. vehatanya: yayin mishsheyyekappe!
Amar rava: la kashya, ha rabbi akiva, ha rabbanan, ditnan: yayin mishsheyyered labbor, rabbi akiva omer: mishsheyyekappe.
Ibbaya lehu: kippuy devor, o kippuy dechavit?
Ta shema, detanya: yayin — mishsheyyekappe, af al pi shekkippa, kolet min haggat haelyona umin hatztzinnor veshote. shema minna kippuy devor kaamrinan, shema minna.

Vehatane rav zevid bidve rabbi oshaya: yayin — mishsheyyered labbor vikappe, rabbi akiva omer: mishsheyyeshalle bechaviyyot! tartza name lehach kammayyta hachi: yayin — mishsheyyered labbor vikappe, rabbi akiva omer: mishsheyyeshalle bechaviyyot.
Veella, matnitin dekatane: eno ose yen nesech ad sheyyered labbor, lema telata tannae hi? la, shane yen nesech deachmiru beh rabbanan.
b: Ulerava, dela shane leh, mokem leh kitlata tannae.
Ma shebbabbor asur vehashshear muttar. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella shello hechezir garguteni laggat, aval hechzir garguteni laggat — asur.
Garguteni gufa, bemay ka mittasra? benitztzok. shema minna: nitztzok chibbur! kidtane rabbi chiyyay: sheppechasattu tzelochito. hacha name: sheppechasattu boro.

Hahu yanoka ditna avoda zara beshet shene, beo minneh: mahu lidroch im hannochri baggat? amar lehu: dorchin im hannochri baggat. veha ka menassech bideh? detzayayrna lehu lideh. veha ka menassech beregel? nissuch deregel la shemeh nissuch.
Hahu ovada dahava binhardea, dedashu yisrael vegoy lehahu chamra, veshahayeh shemuel telata rigle. may tama? illema mishshum dekasavar:

a: Dei mashkachna tanna deasar kerabbi natan, osrinneh afillu bahanaa. detanya: medado, ben bayyad ben baregel — yimmacher. rabbi natan omer: bayyad — asur, baregel — muttar.
Emar deamar rabbi natan bayyad, baregel mi amar? ella dei mashkachna tanna deshare kerabbi shimon, eshreyeh afillu bishtiyyay.
Hahu ovada dahava beveram, dehahu goy dahava ka salek bedikla veayyti lulibba, bahade deka nachet nega bereshe delulibba bechamra shello bechavvavna, sharyeh rav lezabboneh legoyim.
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav, veha mar hu deamar: tinok ben yomo hu ose yen nesech! amar lehu: emor daamari ana bishtiyyay, bahanaa mi amari?
Gufa, amar rav: tinok ben yomo ose yen nesech.
Etiveh rav shimi bar chiyyay lerav: hallokeach avadim min haggoyim, shemmalu velo tavlu, vechen bene hashshefachot, shemmalu velo tavlu — rukkan umidrasan bashshuk tame, veamri la: tahor.

Yenan — gedolim osim yen nesech, ketannim en osim yen nesech. veellu hen gedolim veellu hen ketannim? gedolim — yodin betiv avoda zara umeshammesheha, ketannim — enam yodin betiv avoda zara umeshammesheha.
Katane mihat gedolim — in, ketannim — la! targema abbene shefachot.
Ha "vechen" kaamar! arukkan umidrasan.
Hanicha leman deamar tame, ella leman deamar tahor, may ikka lememar?
Ha ka mashma lan, avadim duvmya divne shefachot, ma bene shefachot malu velo tavlu hu deosin yen nesech, malu vetavlu la, af avadim ken.

Leappoke midderav nachman amar shemuel, deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: hallokeach avadim min haggoyim, af al pi shemmalu vetavlu — osin yen nesech ad shettishka avoda zara mippihem, ka mashma lan dela.

Gufa, amar rav nachman amar shemuel: hallokeach avadim min haggoyim, af al pi shemmalu vetavlu — osin yen nesech ad shettishka avoda zara mippihem. vechamma? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ad shenem asar chodesh.
Etiveh rabba lerav nachman: hallokeach avadim min haggoyim shemmalu velo tavlu, vechen bene hashshefachot shemmalu velo tavlu — rukkan umidrasan
b: Bashshuk tame, veamri la: tahor. yenan — gedolim osin yen nesech, ketannim en osin yen nesech. ellu hen gedolim veellu hen ketannim? gedolim — sheyyodin betiv avoda zara umeshammesheha, ketannim — sheen yodin betiv avoda zara umeshammesheha.
Katane mihat: malu velo tavlu — in, malu vetavlu — la! targema abbene shefachot.
Ha "vechen" katane! arukkan umidrasan.
Hanicha leman deamar tame, ella leman deamar tahor, may ikka lememar?
Ha ka mashma lan: avadim duvmya divne shefachot, ma bene shefachot — gedolim hu deosin yen nesech, ketannim en osin yen nesech, af avadim name — gedolim osin yen nesech, ketannim en osin yen nesech.
Leappoke midderav, deamar rav: tinok ben yomo ose yen nesech, ka mashma lan dela.

Hahu ovada dahava bemachoza, ata goy ayyl lechanuta deyisrael, amar lehu: it lechu chamra lezabbone? amaru leh: la. hava yatev chamra bedavvla, sheda beh yedeh shaychshech beh, amar lehu: hay lav chamra hu? shakleh haych beritcheh shadyeh ledanna.

Sharyeh rava lezabbone legoyim, ippelig aleh rav huna bar chinnana verav huna bereh derav nachman. nafki shippure derava vesharu, venafki shippure derav huna bar chinnana verav huna bar rav nachman veasri.

a: Ikkela rav huna bereh derav nachman lemachoza, amar leh rava lerav elyakim shammaeh: terok galle, dela neto inashe denitroyd.

Al legabbeh, amar leh: ki hay gavvna may? amar leh: asur afillu bahanaa. veha mar hu deamar: shichshech en ose yen nesech! emar daamari ana – levar middemeh dehahu chamra, deme dehahu chamra mi amari?
Amar rava: ki atay lefumebdita, akkefan nachmani shematata umatneyata daasir.
Shematata: dehahu ovada dahava binhardea, vaasar shemuel, bitverya vaasar rabbi yochanan, vaamari leh: lefi sheenan bene tora, vaamar li: teverya unehardea enan bene tora, demachoza bene tora?!
Matneyata: daagardemim goy shekkadach bemeneket veheela, o shettaam min hakkos vehechziro lechavit — ze haya maase vaasaruhu. may lav bahanaa? lo, bishtiyyay.
I hachi, litne "yimmacher", kidkatane sefa: charam goy shehoshit yado lechavit, uchesavur shel shemen hi venimtzet shel yayin — ze haya maase, veamru: "yimmacher". teyuveta derava, teyuveta.

Rabbi yochanan ben arza verabbi yose ben nehoray havo yatvi veka shatu chamra, ata hahu gavra, amaru leh: ta ashkenan. levatar dirma lechasa iggallay milleta degoy hu. chad asar afillu bahanaa, vechad share afillu bishtiyyay. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: man deasar shappir asar, uman deshare shappir share. man deasar,
b: Memar amar: salka dateh derabbanan ki hane shichra ka shatu? ella vadday hay chamra hu, venassecheh. man deshare shappir shere, memar amar: salka datach derabbanan ki hane chamra ka shatu, veamru li ledidi "ta ashkenan"? ella vadday shichra hu (ka shatu), vela nassecheh.
Veha ka chaze! belelya. veha ka morach leh! bechadta.
Veha ka naga beh benatla, vehave leh magga goy shello bechavvavna veasur! la tzericha, deka morek oroke, vehave leh kocho shello bechavvavna, vechol kocho shello bechavvavna la gezaru beh rabbanan.

Bea minneh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan: yayin shemmesacho goy, mahu? amar leh: veema "mezago"! amar leh: ana kedichtiv kaamena, "tavcha tivchah mascha yenah". amar leh: leshon tora leatzmah, leshon chachamim leatzmo.
May? amar leh: asur, mishshum "lach lach, amrin nezira; sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav".

Rabbi yirmeya ikkela lesibbeta, chaza chamra demazgi goyim veishti yisrael minneh, vaasar lehu mishshum "lach lach, amrin nezira; sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav". ittemar name: amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: yayin shemmezago goy asur, mishshum "lach lach, amrin nezira; sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav".
Resh lakish ikkela levotzra, chaza yisrael dekaachli pere dela measseri, vaasar lehu. chaza mayya desagdi lehu goyim veshatu yisrael, vaasar lehu.
Ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: addemiktorach alach zil hadar betzer, lav hayeynu botzra, umayim shel rabbim en neesarin.
Rabbi yochanan letameh,

a: Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: mayim shel rabbim en neesarin. ha deyachid neesarin.
Vetippok leh, deha mechubbarin ninhu! la tzericha, detalshinhu galla.
Sof sof, avne har shenniddaldelu ninhu, tistayyem derabbi yochanan deamar asurot?
La tzericha, detafchinhu bideh.

Rabbi chiyyay bar abba ikkela legavla, chaza benot yisrael demiabberan miggoyim shemmalu velo tavlu, chaza chamra dimzagu goyim veshatu yisrael, chaza tormosa deshalki lehu goyim veachli yisrael, vela amar lehu vela midde.
Ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: tze vehacherez al benehem shehen mamzerim, veal yenan mishshum yen nesech, veal tormosan mishshum bishshule goyim, mishshum sheenan bene tora.

Al benehem shehem mamzerim — rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: leolam eno ger ad sheyyamul veyitbol, vechevan dela tevel — goy hu. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad mamzer.
Ugezur al yenam mishshum yen nesech — mishshum "lach lach, amrin nezira; sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav".

Veal tormosan mishshum bishshule goyim — lefi sheenan bene tora. tama deenan bene tora, ha bene tora shere? vehaamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: kol shenneechol kemot shehu chay en bo mishshum bishshule goyim!

Rabbi yochanan ki hach lishshana sevira leh, deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: kol sheeno ole leshulechan shel melachim lelefet bo et happat — en bo mishshum bishshule goyim. tama deenan bene tora, ha bene tora shere.

Beo minneh merav kahana: goy mahu sheyyolich anavim laggat? amar lehu: asur, mishshum "lach lach, amrin nezira; sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav". etiveh rav yemar lerav kahana: goy shehevi anavim laggat besallin.
b: Uvedudorin, af al pi shehayyayin mezallef alehen — muttar. amar leh: "hevi" kaamrat? ana lechattechilla kaamena!
Hahu etroga dinfal lechavita dechamra, idderi goy veshakleh. amar lehu rav ashe: naktu lideh ki hechi dela leshachshech beh, uvartzuha ad deshayyfa.
Amar rav ashe: hay goy denassecheh lechamra deyisrael bechavvavna, af al gav dilzabboneh legoy acharina asur, shere leh lemishkal demeh mehahu goy. may tama? mikla kalyeh.

Amar rav ashe: mena amena la? detanya: goy shennissech yeno shel yisrael shello bifne avoda zara — asur, verabbi yehuda ben bava verabbi yehuda ben betira mattirin mishshum shene devarim: echad — sheen menassechin yayin ella bifne avoda zara, veechad — sheomer lo: lo kol hemencha shetteesor yeni leonsi.
Hahi chavita dechamra deishtekil levarza, ata goy, idderi annach yedeh illaveh. amar rav pappa: kol delahade barza — chamra asir.

a: Veiddach shere, veikka deamri, amar rav pappa: ad (haberazea) [barza] — chamra asir, veiddach shere.

Amar rav yemar, ketannae: chavit shennikkeva, ben mippiha, ben mishshuleha, uven mitztziddeha, venaga bo tevul yom — temea. rabbi yehuda omer: mippiha umishshuleha — temea, mitztziddeha — tehora mikkan umikkan.
Amar rav pappa: goy addanna veyisrael akkubba — chamra asir, may tama? ki kaate — mikkoach goy kaate. yisrael addanna vegoy akkubba — chamra shere, vei metzadded tzaddode — asir.
Amar rav pappa: hay goy dedare zikka vekaazel yisrael achoreh, malya — shere, dela mekarkesh. chassira — asir, dilma mekarkesh. kubba: malya — asir, dilma naga. chassira — shere, dela naga.
Rav ashe amar: zika, ben malya uven chassira — shere, may tama? en derech nissuch bechach.
Matzera zayyra — rav pappi share, rav ashe, veittema rav shimi bar ashe, asar.

Bechocho, kulle alma la peligi daasir. ki peligi — bechoach kocho. ikka deamri: bechoach kocho, kulle alma la peligi dishre. ki peligi — bechocho. hava ovada bechoach kocho, veasar rav yaakov minnehar pekod.
Hahi chavita
b: Deippekaa leureka, idderi hahu goy chabbeka, sharyay rafram bar pappa, vei tema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, lezabbone legoyim. vehane mille difkaa leureka, aval lefuteyay — afillu bishtiyya shere. may tama? maase levena kaaved.
Hahu goy deishtechach dahava kae bematzarta, amar rav ashe: i ikka tofeach lehatepiach — bae haddacha uvae nigguv, vei la — behaddacha bealma saggi leh.
Mishna nochri shennimtza omed betzad habbor shel yayin, im yesh lo milva alav — asur, en lo milva alav — muttar.

Nafal labbor veala, medado bekane, hittiz et hatztzira bekane, o shehaya metappeach al pi chavit meruttachat — bechol ellu haya maase veamru: yimmacher, verabbi shimon mattir. natal et hechavit uzerakah bachamato labbor, ze haya maase vehichshiru.
Gemara amar shemuel: vehu sheyyesh lo milva al oto yayin.

Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, ditnan: hametaher yeno shel nochri venotno birshuto, vehalla kotev lo: "hitkabbalti mimmecha maot" — muttar, aval im yirtze yisrael lehotzio veen mannicho ad sheyyitten lo meotav, ze haya maase bevet shean veasru.
Tama deen mannicho, ha mannicho shere, shema minna: milva al oto yayin baenan. shema minna.
Nafal labbor veala. amar rav pappa: lo shanu ella sheala met, aval ala chay — asur. may tama? amar rav pappa: dedame aleh keyom edam.

Medado bekane vechulei. kol ellu haya maase veamru: yimmacher, verabbi shimon mattir. amar rav adda bar ahava: yanuchu lo lerabbi shimon berachot al rosho, keshehu mattir — mattir afillu bishtiyya, ucheshehu oser — oser afillu bahanaa.

Amar rav chiyyay bereh deabba bar nachmani, amar rav chisda amar rav, veamri la amar rav chisda amar zeeri: halacha kerabbi shimon. ikka deamri, amar rav chisda: amar li abba bar chanan, hachi amar zeeri: halacha kerabbi shimon. veen halacha kerabbi shimon.
Natal chavit uzerakah [bachamato] labbor, ze haya maase [vehichshiru]. amar rav ashe: kol shebbazzav tame begoy ose yen nesech, kol shebbazzav tahor begoy eno ose yen nesech.
Etiveh rav huna lerav ashe: natal et hechavit uzerakah bachamato labbor, ze haya maase bevet shean vehichshiru. bachamato — in, shello bachamato — la!

a: Hatam, dekaazel minneh uminneh.

Mishna hametaher yeno shel nochri, venotno birshuto (uvevet) [bevayit] happatuach lirshut harabbim, beir sheyyesh bah goyim veyisreelim — muttar, beir shekkullah goyim — asur, ad sheyyeshev umeshammer.
Veen hashshomer tzarich lihyot yoshev umeshammer, af al pi shehu yotze venichnas — muttar. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: reshut goyim achat hi.

Hametaher yeno shel nochri venotno birshuto, vehalla kotev lo: "hitkabbalti mimmecha maot" — muttar, aval im yirtze yisrael lehotzi veeno mannicho ad sheyyitten lo et meotav, ze haya maase bevet shean veasru.
Gemara beir shekkullah goyim name, vehaikka rochlin hammachzirin baayayrot! amar shemuel: beir sheyyesh lah delatayim uveriach.
Amar rav yosef: vechallon kirshut harabbim dame, veashpa kirshut harabbim dame, vedikla kirshut harabbim dame.
Pesik resheh — peligi ba rav acha veravina: chad asar, vechad share. man deasar — lema leh desalek hatam? uman deshare — zimnin deavda leh behema, vesalek leayyone batra.
Tanu rabbanan: echad hallokeach veechad hassocher bayit bachatzero shel goy, umilleahu yayin, veyisrael dar beotah chatzer — muttar, veaf al pi sheen mafteach vechotam beyado.
b: Bechatzer acheret — muttar, vehu shemmafteach vechotam beyado.
Hametaher yeno shel goy birshuto, veyisrael dar beotah chatzer — muttar, vehu shemmafteach vechotam beyado. amar leh rabbi yochanan letanna, tane: af al pi sheen mafteach vechotam beyado — muttar.
Bechatzer acheret — asur, af al pi shemmafteach vechotam beyado, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim osrin, ad sheyyehe shomer yoshev umeshammer, o ad sheyyavo memunne habba lekitztzin.
Chachamim aheyay? illema assefa — tanna kamma name mesar ka asar! veella aresha desefa, veha kaamar leh rabbi yochanan letanna: tane af al pi sheen mafteach vechotam beyado!

Veella, assefa deresha, dekaamar tanna kamma: bechatzer acheret muttar, vehu shemmafteach vechotam beyado. vachachamim omrim: leolam asur, ad sheyyehe shomer yoshev umeshammer, o ad sheyyavo memunne habba lekitztzin.
Memunne ba lekitztzin geriuta hu! ella ad sheyyavo memunne sheeno ba lekitztzin.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: reshut goyim achat hi. ibbaya lehu: rabbi shimon ben elazar lehakel o lehachemir? rav yehuda amar zeeri: lehakel. rav nachman amar zeeri: lehachemir.
Rav yehuda amar zeeri lehakel, vehachi kaamar tanna kamma: keshem shebbirshuto asur, kach birshut goy acher name asur, vechayyshinan legomlin.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: bamme devarim amurim? birshuto, aval birshut goy acher — muttar, vela chayyshinan legomlin.

Rav nachman amar zeeri lehachemir, vehachi kaamar tanna kamma: bamme devarim amurim? birshuto, aval birshut goy acher — muttar, vela chayyshinan legomlin. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol reshut goyim achat hi.
Tanya kevavteh derav nachman amar zeeri lehachemir: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol reshut goyim achat hi mippene harammain.

Deve parzak rufila otivu chamra gabbe arisayyhu, sevur rabbanan kammeh derava lememar: ki chayyshinan legomlin — hane mille hecha deka motev hay gabbe hay, aval hacha, kevan daariseh lav darkeh leotoveh be parzak rufila — legomlin la chayyshinan.
Amar lehu rava: adderabba, afillu leman deamar la chayyshinan legomlin, hane mille hecha dela mirtat minneh, aval hacha, kevan demirtat minneh — mechappe aleh zechuta.
Hahu karcha dahava yatev beh chamra deyisrael, ishtechach goy dahava kae bene danne. amar rava: im nitpas alav kegannav — chamra shere, vei la — asur.
Hadaran alach rabbi yishmael.

a: Mishna hassocher et happoel laasot immo beyen nesech — secharo asur. secharo laasot immo melacha acheret, af al pi sheamar lo "haaver li chavit shel yayin nesech mimmakom lemakom" — secharo muttar. hassocher et hachamor lehavi aleha yen nesech — secharah asur. secharah leshev aleha, af al pi shehinniach goy legino aleha — secharah muttar.
Gemara may tama secharo asur? illema, hoil veyen nesech asur bahanaa, secharo name asur — hare orla vechile hakkerem daasurin bahanaa, utenan: mecharan vekiddesh bidmehen — mekuddeshet!

Ella, hoil vetofes et damav kaavoda zara. vahare sheviit detofeset et dameha, utenan: haomer lefoel "helach dinar ze, lekot li bo yarak hayyom" — secharo asur, "lekot li yarak hayyom" — secharo muttar!

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kenas hu shekkansu chachamim bachamarin uveyen nesech. yen nesech — ha daamaran, chammarin may hi? detanya: hachammarin shehayu osin melacha beferot sheviit — secharan sheviit.
May "secharan sheviit"? illema deyahavinan lehu sachar mipperot sheviit, nimtza ze porea chovo mipperot sheviit, vehattora amra: "leochla" velo lischora!
Veella dekadosh secharan bikdushshat sheviit. umi kadosh? vehatanya: haomer lefoel: "helach dinar ze ulekot li yarak hayyom" — secharo muttar, "lekot li yarak bo hayyom" — secharo asur!
Amar abbaye: leolam yahavinan leh sachar mipperot sheviit, udeka kashya lach "leochla" velo lischora, deyahaveh nihaleh betzad hetter, keditnan: lo yomar adam lachavero:
b: "Haale li perot hallalu lirushalayim lechallek", aval omer lo: "haalem leochlam velishtotam birushalayim", venotnin ze laze mattana shel chinnam.

Verava amar: leolam dekadosh bikdushshat sheviit, udeka kashya lach poel — poel dela nefish agreh la kansu rabbanan, chammarin dinfish agrayyhu — kenasu rabbanan behu. umatnitin — chumera deyen nesech shane.
Ibbaya lehu: secharo listam yenan, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan deissura chamur kidyen nesech — secharo name asur, o dilma: hoil vetumeato (kil) [kila] — af secharo name kil?
Ta shema: dehahu gavra deogar arbeh listam yenan, yehavu leh chitte beagra, ata lekammeh derav chisda, amar leh: zil kelinhu vekivrinhu (bekivre) [be kivre].
Velema leh: badderinhu! atu behu lide takkala. veliklinhu velivadderinhu! dilma mezabbeli behu.
Velikberinhu beenayyhu! mi la tenan: echad even shenniskal bah, veechad etz shennitla alav, veechad sayif shenneherag bo, veechad sudar shennechnak bo — kullam nikbarim immo?
Hatam deka kavri beve dina, mochcha milleta daharuge bet din ninhu. hacha la mochcha milleta, emar: inash genav veayyti kevar hacha.
Deve rabbi yannay yazfi pere sheviit meaniyyim, ufaru lehu bishminit. ato amaru leh lerabbi yochanan, amar lehu: yaut hen avdin.
Uchenegdan beetnan — muttar, detanya: natan lah velo ba aleha, ba aleha velo natan lah — etnanna muttar.
Natan lah velo ba aleha — peshita, kevan dela ba aleha mattana bealma hu deyahev la! vetu, ba aleha velo natan lah — ha la yahev lah vela midde, vechevan dela natan lah may "etnanna muttar"?
Ella hachi kaamar: natan lah veachar kach ba aleha, o ba aleha veachar kach natan lah — etnanna muttar.
Natan lah veachar kach ba aleha, lechi ba aleha

a: Lechul ala issur etnan lemafrea! amar rabbi eliezer: keshekkadma vehikrivattu.
Hechi dame? i deamar la: "kenay lich meachshav" — peshita dishre, deha leteh bishat bia, umattana bealma hu deyahev la!
Vei dela amar la "kenay lich meachshav", hechi (matze) [matzya] makreva? "veish ki yakdish et beto kodesh" amar rachamana, ma beto birshuto, af kol birshuto.
Ella, deamar la: "leheve gabbich ad sheat bia, vei mitzterich lich kenay meachshav".
Bae rav hoshaya: kadma vehikdishattu, mahu? kevan deamar mar: amirato legavoah kimsirato lehedyot, keman deakrevteh dame, o dilma hasheta miha ha kae veiteh beeneh?
Vetifshot midderabbi eliezer, deamar rabbi eliezer: shekkadma vehikrivattu — davka hikrivattu, aval hikdishattu — la.

Derabbi eliezer gufeh ka mibbaya leh, may? mifshat peshita leh lerabbi eliezer dehikrivattu davka, aval hikdishattu — la, deha iteh bishat bia? o dilma hikrivattu peshita leh, vehikdishattu mesappeka leh? teku.
Ba aleha veachar kach natan lah etnannah — muttar, ureminhi: ba aleha veachar kach natan lah, afillu mikkan ad shalosh shanim — etnannah asur!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak amar rav chisda: la kashya, ha deamar "hitbaali li betale ze", ha daamar la "hitbaali betale" setam.
Vechi amar la "betale ze" may have? ha mechassar meshicha! bezona goya, dela kanya bimshicha. veibbaet ema: leolam bezona yisreelit, uchegon dekae bachatzerah.

I dekae bachatzerah, ba aleha veachar kach natan lah, ha kanya le! la tzericha, deshavveye nihala appoteke, daamar la: "i mayytena lich zuze mikkan ad yom peloni — mutav, vei la — shikleh beetnannich".
Metiv rav sheshet: omer adam lachamarav ulefoalav "lechu veichlu bedinar ze", "tzeu ushetu bedinar ze", veeno choshesh
b: Lo mishshum sheviit, velo mishshum maaser, velo mishshum yen nesech.
Veim amar lahem: "tzeu veichlu vaani porea", "tzeu ushetu vaani porea" — choshesh mishshum sheviit, umishshum maaser, umishshum yen nesech.
Alma, ki ka fara — deme issur ka fara; hacha name, ki ka fara — deme issura ka fara.
Targema rav chisda bechenvani hammakkifo, demishtabad leh, dechevan deorcheh leakkofe — kene leh dinar gabbeh.
Aval chenvani sheen makkifo may muttar? i hachi, addetane "tzeu veichlu bedinar ze", "tzeu ushetu bedinar ze", liflog velitne bedida:
Bamme devarim amurim? bechenvani hammakkifo, demishtabad leh, aval chenvani sheen makkifo — muttar.
Veod: chenvani sheen makkifo mi la mishtabad? vehaamar rava: haomer lachavero "ten mane lifloni veyikkanu kol nechasay lach", kana middin arev!
Ella amar rava: la shena makkifo, vela shena sheen makkifo, af al gav dimshabad leh, kevan dela meyaychad shibudeh — la mittesar.
Ella hacha ammay choshesh mishshum sheviit? ha la meyaychad shibudeh hacha! amar rav pappa: kegon shehikdim lo dinar.

Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, amar li: i hachi, addetane "tzeu veichlu, tzeu ushetu, vaani porea", "tzeu veichlu, tzeu ushetu, vaani mechashshev" mibbee leh! amar leh: teni "tzeu vaani mechashshev".

Rav ashe amar: kegon shennatal venatan bayyad. amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: i hachi, addetane "tzeu veichlu, tzeu ushetu", "telu veichlu, telu ushetu" mibbee leh! amar leh: tane "telu veichlu, telu ushetu".

Yatev rav nachman veulla vaavimi bar pappi, veyatev rabbi chiyyay bar amme gabbayyhu, veyatvi veka mibbaya lehu: secharo lishbor beyen nesech mahu? mi amrinan kevan derotze bekiyyumo — asur, o dilma kol lemaote tifla shappir dame?
Amar rav nachman: yishbor, vetavo alav beracha. lema mesayyay leh: en odrin im haggoy bechilayim,

a: Aval okrin immo, kede lemaevtoy et hattifla.
Savruha: ha manni? rabbi akiva hi, deamar: hamekayyem bechilayim loke. detanya: hamenakkesh vehamechappe bechilayim loke, rabbi akiva omer: af hamekayyem.
May tama derabbi akiva? amar kera: "sadcha lo tizra kilayim", en li ella zorea, mekayyem minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo kilayim".
Veillu lemaote tifla — shere.
La, ha manni? rabbanan hi.
I rabbanan, may irya okrin? afillu kayyome name shappir dame! hacha bemay askinan? kegon deka aved bechinnam, verabbi yehuda hi, deamar: litten lahem mattenat chinnam asur.

Midderabbi yehuda nishma lerabbi akiva, lav amar rabbi yehuda: asur litten lahem mattenat chinnam, aval lemaote tifla shappir dame. lerabbi akiva name, af al gav deamar rabbi akiva: hamekayyem bechilayim loke, lemaote tifla shappir dame. vetu la middi.
Hadur yatvi vekamibbaya lehu: deme avoda zara beyad goy, mahu? mi tofeset dameha beyad goy, o la?
Amar lehu rav nachman: mistabbera deme avoda zara beyad goy muttarin, middehanhu daato lekammeh derabba bar avu, amar lehu: zilu zabbinu kol ma deit lechu, vetu itgayyayru.
May tama? mishshum dekasavar: deme avoda zara beyad goy muttarin. vedilma shane hatam, dechevan dedateh leiggayyore — vadday battela!

Ella mehacha: yisrael shehaya noshe begoy mane, umachar avoda zara vehevi lo, yen nesech vehevi lo — muttar, aval im amar lo: "hameten li ad sheemkor avoda zara veavi lach", "yen nesech veavi lach" — asur.
May shena resha umay shena sefa? amar rav sheshet: sefa, mishshum dehave leh ki rotze bekiyyumo.

Vechi rotze bekiyyumo kehay gavvna mi asir? vehatnan: ger vegoy sheyyarshu avihen goy, ger yachol lomar lo: "tol atta avoda zara vaani maot", "tol atta yen nesech vaani perot"; im mishshebbau lirshut hagger — asur.
Amar rava bar ulla: matnitin baavoda zara hammitchalleket lefi shevareha.
Tinach avoda zara, yen nesech may ikka lememar? becheres haderyayni.
Vahalo rotze bekiyyumo, shello yigganevvu veshello yeavedu! ella amar rav pappa: yerushshat hagger kaamrat? shane yerushshat hagger, deakkilu ba rabbanan, gezera shemma yachzor lekilkulo.
b: Tanya name hachi: bamme devarim amurim? sheyyarshu, aval nishtattefu — asur.
Hadur yetavu vekamibbaya lehu: ger toshav mahu sheyyevattel avoda zara? defalach — mevattel, dela palach — la mevattel, o dilma kol devar minneh mevattel, vehay bar mineh hu?
Amar lehu rav nachman: mistabbera, defalach — mevattel, dela palach — la mevattel.

Metivi: yisrael shemmatza avoda zara bashshuk, ad shello bata leyado — omer legoy umevattelah, mishshebbata leyado — eno omer legoy umevattelah; mippene sheamru: goy mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero, ben ovdah uven sheen ovdah.
May "ovdah", umay "sheeno ovdah"? illema idde veidde goy, hayeynu shello veshel chavero! ella lav "ovdah" — goy, umay "sheeno ovdah" — ger toshav, ushema minna ger toshav name mevattel!
La, leolam ema lach: idde veidde goy, udekaamrat hayeynu "shello veshel chavero": resha — ze vaze lifor, veze vaze lemarkulis; sefa — ze lifor veze lemarkulis.
Metivi: ezehu ger toshav? kol shekkibbel alav bifne shelosha chaverim shello laavod avoda zara, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: kol shekkibbel alav sheva mitzvot shekkibbelu alehem bene noach.
Acherim omrim: ellu lo bau lichlal ger toshav, ella ezehu ger toshav? ze ger ochel nevelot, shekkibbel alav lekayyem kol mitzvot haamurot battora chutz meissur nevelot.
Meyaychadin etzlo yayin, veen mafkidin etzlo yayin, vaafillu beir sherubbah yisrael, aval meyaychadin etzlo yayin vaafillu beir sherubbah goyim, shamno keyeno.
Shamno keyeno salka datach? shemen mi ka have yen nesech? ella, yeno keshamno.
Velishar kol davar hare hu kegoy. rabban shimon omer: yeno yen nesech, veamri la muttar bishtiyya.
Katane miha: velishar kol devarav hare hu kegoy. lemay hilcheta? lav dimvattel avoda zara kegoy? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo, litten reshut ulevattel reshut.
Vechidtanya: yisrael meshummad meshammer shabbatto bashshuk — mevattel reshut, sheen meshammer shabbatto bashshuk — en mevattel reshut, mippene sheamru: yisrael noten reshut umevattel reshut.
Uvegoy — ad sheyyiskor. ketzad? omer lo: "reshuti kenuya lach", "reshuti mevuttelet lach" — kana, veen tzarich lizkot.
Rav yehuda shaddar leh kurebana

a: Laavidarna beyom edam, amar: yadana beh dela palach laavoda zara. amar leh rav yosef: vehatanya: ezehu ger toshav? kol shekkibbel alav bifne shelosha chaverim shello laavod avoda zara! ki tanya hahi — lehacheyoto.
Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ger toshav sheavru alav shenem asar chodesh velo mal, hare hu kemin shebbaummot! hatam kegon shekkibbel alav lamul velo mal.

Rava amti leh kurebana levar sheshach beyom edam. amar: yadana beh dela palach laavoda zara. azal ashkecheh deyatev ad tzavvereh bevavrda, vekayyman zonot arummot kammeh. amar leh: it lechu kehay gavvna lealma deate? amar leh: didan adifa tefe mehay. amar leh: tefe mehay mi have? amar leh: attun ikka alayychu emta demalchuta, anan la tehve alan emta demalchuta. amar leh: ana miha may emta demalchuta ikka alay?
Ad deyatvi, ata hahu peristaka demalka, amar leh: kum, dekavae lach malka. ki nafek veazel, amar leh: ena devae lemichze lechu bishuta tifka. amar leh rava: amen. peka eneh devar sheshach.

Amar rav pappi: ibbei leh lememra leh mehay kera "benot melachim beyikkerotecha nitztzeva shegal limincha bechetem ofir". amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ibbei leh lememra leh mehacha "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo".
Secharo laasot immo melacha acheret. veaf al gav dela amar leh leittote erev.
Ureminhi: hassocher et happoel, uleittote erev amar lo: "haaver chavit shel yayin nesech mimmakom lemakom" — secharo muttar. tama daamar leh leittote erev — in, kulle yoma — la!
Amar abbaye: ki tenan name matnitin, deamar leittote erev tenan. rava amar: la kashya, ha daamar leh: "haaver li mea chaviyyot bemea perutot", ha daamar leh: "haaver li chavit chavit bifruta".

Vehatanya: hassocher et happoel, veamar lo: "haaver li mea chaviyyot bemea perutot", venimtzet chavit shel yen nesech benehen — secharo asur. chavit chavit bifruta, venimtzet chavit shel yen nesech benehen — secharo muttar.
Hassocher et hachamor lehavi aleha yen nesech — secharo asur. ha tu lema li? hayeynu resha! sefa itztericha leh: secharah leshev aleha, af al pi shehinniach goy legino aleha — secharo muttar.
Lememra, delagin lav dina hu leotoveh?

Ureminhi: hassocher et hachamor — socher manniach aleha kesuto uleginato umezonotav shel oto hadderech, mikkan veelach chammar meakkev alav. chammar manniach aleha seorim veteven umezonotav shel oto hayyom, mikkan veelach socher meakkev alav.
Amar abbaye: nehi delagin dina hu leotove, miha i la motev leh, mi amrinan leh: nakki leh agra dilginato?
Hechi dame? i dishchiach lemizban — chammar name leakkev, vei dela shechiach lemizban — socher name la leakkev.
Amar rav pappa: la tzericha dishchiach lemitrach ulemizban meavvana leavvana, chammar darkeh lemitrach ulemizban, socher lav darkeh lemitrach ulemizban.
Avu derav acha bereh derav ika
b: Hava shafech lehu chamra legoyim, veazel meabbar lehu mabara, veyahavu leh gulefe beagra. ato amaru leh leabbaye, amar lehu: ki ka tarach — behettera ka tarach.
Veha rotze bekiyyumo, dela nitztero zike! dematne bahadayyhu? i name, demayytu (perisdeke) [pardiske] bahadayyhu.
Veha ka meabbar lehu mabara, deka tarach beissura! daamar leh lemabbaroya meikkara, i name, dinkiti beh kitre.

Mishna yen nesech shennafal al gabbe anavim — yaddichen vehen muttarot, veim hayu mevukkaot — asurot. nafal al gabbe teenim o al gabbe temarim, im yesh bahen benoten taam — asur. umaase bevaytos ben zunen shehevi gerogrot bisfina, venishtabbera chavit shel yen nesech venafal al gabbehen, veshaal lachachamim vehittirum.
Ze hakkelal: kol shebbahanaato benoten taam — asur, kol sheen bahanaato benoten taam — muttar, kegon chometz shennafal al gabbe gerisin.

Gemara maase listor? chassore michassera, vehachi katane: im noten taam lifgam hu — muttar, umaase name bevaytos ben zunen shehaya mevi gerogrot bisfina, venishtabbera chavit shel yen nesech venafal al gabbehen, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittirum.
Hahu (keri) [karya] dechitte dinfal aleh chavita deyen nesech, sharyeh rava lezabboneh legoyim.
Etiveh rabba bar levay lerava: beged sheavad bo kilayim, hare ze lo yimkerenna legoy, velo yaasenna mardaat lachamor, aval ose oto tachrichin lemet mitzva.
Legoy may tama la? dilma ate lezabboneh leyisrael, hacha name ate lezabboneh leyisrael!
Hadar shera lemittechinhu velimfinhu ulezabboninhu legoyim, shello bifne yisrael.

Tenan: yen nesech shennafal al gabbe anavim — yaddichen vehen muttarot, veim hayu mevukkaot — asurot. mevukkaot — in, sheen mevukkaot — la. amar rav pappa: shane chitte, hoil veaggav tzirayyhu kimvukkaot damyayn.

a: Chamra attika beinve, divre hakkol benoten taam. chamra chadta beinve, abbaye amar: bemashshehu, verava amar: benoten taam.
Abbaye amar: bemashshehu, batar tama azlinan, idde veidde chad tama hu, dehave leh min bemino, umin bemino bemashshehu.
Verava amar: benoten taam, batar shema azlinan, vehay shema lechud vehay shema lechud, vehave leh min besheeno mino, umin besheeno mino benoten taam.
Tenan: yen nesech shennafal al gabbe anavim kulei. ka salka datin: chamra chadta beinve, may lav benoten taam? la, bemashshehu.
Ha middekatane sefa, ze hakkelal: kol shebbahanaato benoten taam — asur, kol sheen bahanaato benoten taam — muttar, mikkelal divnoten taam askinan!
Veabbaye, matnitin bechamra attika beinve.

Challa dechamra vechalla deshichra, vachamira dechitte vachamira disare, abbaye amar: benoten taam, batar tama azlinan, vehay tama lechud vehay tama lechud, vehave leh min besheeno mino, umin besheeno mino benoten taam.
Verava amar: bemashshehu, batar shema azlinan, vehay challa mikkere vehay challa mikkere, vehay chamira mikkere vehay chamira mikkere, vahava leh min bemino, vechol min bemino bemashshehu.

Amar abbaye: mena amena la devatar tama azlinan? detanya: tavlin shenayim ushelosha shemot, vehen min echad, o min shelosha — asurin umitztarfin. veamar chizkiyya: hacha bemine metika askinan, hoil ureuyin lemattek bahen et hakkedera. i amrat bishlama batar tama azlinan — kulle chad tama hu, ella i amrat batar shema azlinan — hay shema lechud vehay shema lechud!

Verava amar lach: ha manni? rabbi meir hi, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi meir: minnayin lechol issurin shebbattora shemmitztarfin ze im ze? shenneemar: "lo tochal kol toeva", kol shettiavti lach — hare hu beval tochal.
Challa lego chamra — divre hakkol benoten taam. chamra lego challa — abbaye amar: bemashshehu, verava amar: benoten taam.
Abbaye amar: bemashshehu,
b: Recheh challa vetama chamra — challa, vehave leh min bemino, vechol min bemino — bemashshehu.
Rava amar: benoten taam, recheh challa vetama chamra — chamra, vehave leh min besheeno mino, vechol min besheeno mino benoten taam.
Hay bat tiha, goy bidyisrael — shappir dame, yisrael bidgoy — abbaye amar: asur, rava amar: muttar. abbaye amar: asur, recha milleta hi. rava amar: muttar, recha lav milleta hi.

Amar rava: mena amena la, derecha vela kelum hu? ditnan: tannur shehissiko bechammon shel teruma veafa bo et happat — happat mutteret, lefi sheen taam kammon ella recha kammon. veabbayye? shane hatam, demikla issureh.

Amar rav mari: ketannae, harode pat chamma unetanah al pi chavit shel yayin shel teruma — rabbi meir oser, verabbi yehuda mattir. rabbi yose mattir beshel chittin, veoser beshel seorim, mippene shehasseorim shoavot. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: recha milleta hi, umar savar: recha vela kelum hu?
Lerava vadday tannae hi, leabbaye mi lema tannae hi?
Amar lach abbaye: lav mi ittemar ala, amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish: befat chamma vechavit petucha —

a: Divre hakkol asura, befat tzonenet vechavit megufa — divre hakkol mutteret. lo nechleku ella befat chamma vechavit megufa, befat tzonenet vechavit petucha. veha didi name kefat chamma vechavit petucha dame.
Ze hakkelal, kol shebbahanaato benoten taam kulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hachi hilcheta.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella shennafal letoch gerisin rotchin, aval nafal letoch gerisin tzonnin vehirtichan, naasa kemi shehishbiach ulevassof pagam, veasur.

Vechen ki ata ravin amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shennafal letoch gerisin rotchin, aval nafal letoch gerisin tzonnin vehirtichan, naasa kemi shehishbiach ulevassof pagam, veasur. vechen ki ata rav dimi kulei. vechach hayu osin bearve shabbatot betzippori, vekorin otam shachalayim.
Amar resh lakish: noten taam lifgam sheamru, lo sheyyomru: kedera zo chasera melach, yetera melach, chasera tavlin, yetera tavlin, ella kol sheen chasera kelum, veenah neechelet mippene ze.
Veikka deamri, amar resh lakish: noten taam lifgam sheamru, en omrin: kedera zo chasera melach, yetera melach, chasera tavlin, yetera tavlin, ella hasheta miha ha pagma.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kol shettamo umammasho asur, lokin alav, vezehu kezayit bichde achilat peras.
b: Tamo velo mammasho — asur, veen lokin alav, veim ribba taam lifgam — muttar.
Velema: im natan taam lifgam — muttar! ha kamashma lan, deaf al gav deikka mille achranyayta defagma bahadeh, vehilcheta kelishshana batra deresh lakish.
Amar rav kahana: middivre kullam nilmad noten taam lifgam muttar. amar leh abbaye: bishlama mikkullehu lechayye, ella deresh lakish — "amru" kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.
Mikkelal deikka leman deamar: noten taam lifgam — asur?
In, vehatanya: echad noten taam lifgam veechad noten taam leshevach — asur, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer: leshevach — asur, velifgam — muttar.
May tama derabbi meir? gamar miggiule goyim, giule goyim lav noten taam lifgam hu? veasar rachamana, hachi name la shena.
Veiddach? kidrav huna bereh derav chiyyay, deamar rav huna bereh derav chiyyay: lo asra tora ella kedera bat yoma, dela lifgam hu. veiddach? kedera bat yoma name i efshar dela pagma pureta.
Verabbi shimon, may tama? detanya: "lo tochlu kol nevela lagger asher bisharecha", kol haruya lagger — keruya nevela,

a: Sheen reuya leger — enah keruya nevela.
Verabbi meir, hahu lemaote serucha meikkara, verabbi shimon — serucha meikkara la tzericha miuta, afra bealma hu.
Amar ulla: machloket shehishbiach ulevassof pagam, aval pagam meikkara — divre hakkol muttar.
Etiveh rav chagga leulla: yayin shennafal letoch adashim, vechometz shennafal letoch gerisin — asur, verabbi shimon mattir. veha hacha difgam meikkara hu, ufeligi!
Amar ulla: chagga la midda yada may kaamri rabbanan, teyuveta ka motev? hacha bemay askinan? kegon shennafal letoch gerisin tzonnin vehirticham, naasa kemi shehishbiach ulevassof pagam, veasur.
Verabbi yochanan amar: befogem meikkara machloket.
Ibbaya lehu: befogem meikkara machloket, aval hishbiach ulevassof pagam — divre hakkol asur, o dilma ben bazo uven bazo machloket? teku.
Amar rav amram: efshar ita leha derabbi yochanan, vela tanya la bematnitin?

Nefak dak veashkach, detanya: seor shel chullin shennafal letoch haissa, veyesh bo kede lehachemitz vehechmitza, veachar kach nafal seor shel teruma o seor shel kile hakkerem veyesh bo kede lehachemitz — asur, verabbi shimon mattir.
Veha hacha, difgam meikkara hu, ufeligi!
Amar rabbi zera: shane issa, hoil ureuya lechammea bah kamma issot acherot.

Ta shema: seor shel teruma veshel chullin shennaflu letoch haissa, beze kede lehachemitz uveze kede lehachemitz vechimmetzu — asur, verabbi shimon mattir. nafal shel teruma techilla — divre hakkol asur. nafal shel chullin veachar kach nafal shel teruma o shel kile hakkerem — asur, verabbi shimon mattir.
Veha hacha, difgam meikkara, ufeligi! vechi tema: hacha name
b: Kidrabbi zera, ta shema missefa: hayyayin shennafal letoch adashim, vechometz shennafal letoch gerisin — asur, verabbi shimon mattir. veha hachi name difgam meikkara, ufeligi!
Vechi tema, hacha name kidshanni leh ulla lerabbi chagga: keshehishbiach ulevassof pagam, umi peligi keshehishbiach ulevassof pagam? veha katane: nafal shel teruma techilla — divre hakkol asur!
Ella lav shema minna, bifgam meikkara machloket? shema minna.
Hane telata bave dekatane, lema li? bishlama bava desefa, ka mashma lan: befogem meikkara machloket. metziata name, hishbiach ulevassof pagam — divre hakkol asur.
Ella resha lema li? hasheta, uma sefa dela ka mashbach kelal, asri rabbanan, resha deka mashbach mibbaya?
Amar abbaye: resha lerabbi shimon itzterich, vehachi kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi shimon: issa zo reuya lehachemitz bishte shaot, mi garam lah shettachamitz beshaa achat? issur.
Verabbi shimon? keshehishbichu, shenehem hishbichu; kesheppagmu, shenehem pagmu.
Lerabbi shimon, litztaref hetter veissur bahade hadade velittesar!
Rabbi shimon letameh, deamar: afillu issur veissur name la mitztarfi,
Ditnan: haorla vechile hakkerem mitztarfin, rabbi shimon omer: en mitztarfin.
Hahu achbera dinfal lechavita deshichra, asreh rav lehahu shichra. amruha rabbanan kammeh derav sheshet: nema kasavar noten taam lifgam asur?
Amar lehu rav sheshet: bealma savar rav noten taam lifgam muttar, vehacha chiddush hu, deha mimas meis uvedili inashe minneh, vaafillu hachi asreh rachamana. hilkach noten taam lifgam name asur.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav sheshet: ella meatta, litamme lach veyavesh, allema tenan: metammein lachim veen metammein yeveshim?
Uletamaych, shichvat zera tetamme lach veyavesh, allema tenan: metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin?
Ella may it lach lememar? "shichvat zera" amar rachamana, biruya lehazeria. hacha name, "bemotam" amar rachamana, keen motam.
Matkef la rav shimi minnehardea: umi meis? vahalo ole al shulchan shel melachim! amar rav shimi minnehardea: la kashya, ha biddavra, ha bidmata.

Amar rava: hilcheta noten taam lifgam muttar, veachbera beshichra la yadana may tama derav, i mishshum dekasavar noten taam lifgam asur, velet hilcheta kevavteh, i mishshum dekasavar noten taam lifgam muttar, veachbera beshichra ashboche mashbach.
